notes.title: Big Changes: v1.0.32
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to Update 1.0.32 of Those Left Behind! This update introduces significant changes to the game:

[olist]
[*] 1st person perspective is now available, and is the default perspective
[*] music is available while scavenging the world and is turned on by default
[*] guns now have a functional dynamic crosshair (running, turning, shooting the gun, and getting hit by zombies affects the accuracy of the your gunshot)
[*] items and other interactables (e.g. doors) will now have an outline whenever you get close to them
[/olist]

Thanks for reading!
M

notes.title: Looking Back... And Then Looking Forward
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

It's been almost three weeks since [i]Those Left Behind[/i] was launched. There have been a few patches to fix bugs and add features. Probably the most important new feature was the "Visibility Test". https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2101070/view/3717198571775734521?l=english)


Through MainMenu->Settings->Graphics, players can now conduct a visibility test during which they can adjust the brightness of the world to just the right level given their monitor and computer setup. This was vital, as the right level of darkness is essential to immersing the player into the world.

Still, I know that [i]Those Left Behind[/i] can be better and I want to make it so. I'll be thinking of ways to do that, but I'd also appreciate some feedback from the players! If you find any bugs or there are some things about the game that you find annoying/troublesome, I'd like to hear about them. Contact me through the discord link embedded in the game's MainMenu.

In the meantime, here are two things that I'll be working on:
[olist]
[*]Localization
[list]
[*] El juego estará localizado al español.
[*]游戏将本地化为中文
[/list]
[*]Adding a shotgun to the game
[/olist]

Thanks for reading this post!

Cheers,
ZDevStudio

P.S. #1 Please enjoy this recently released youtube video made for one of [i]Those Left Behind[/i]'s levels, [i][b]Manor[/b][/i].
https://youtu.be/ra2OF7JbrWw

P.S. #2 If you like the game, please tell your friends about it and leave a steam review!

notes.title: v1.0.25 - Bullet Penetration
notes.content:
v1.0.25
Balance
1. add bullet penetration (penetrating bullets DO NOT go through walls, only doors and bodies)
	[list]
[*] the Desert Eagle can damage up to 3 objects; each additional enemy takes 20% less damage
[*] 	the M4 and AR 15 can damage up to 2 objects; the second enemy takes 50% less damage (note: silenced weapons have no bullet penetration)
[/list]

Fix
1. improve collisions on several meshes
2. improve level pathing for "Hospital" map
remove some unintentional "ai-navigational dark zones" (areas that AI can't pass through )

Other
1. add button that allows player to return to first-time-brightness-adjustment screen (MainMenu->Settings->Graphics->Brightness-ConductVisibilityTest)
2. add "notes" to several levels ("notes" are messages left behind ordinary people living their lives)
3. add & improve "note" meshes

notes.title: v1.0.21 - Weapon Durability Change and Solar Weather Improvement
notes.content:
v1.0.21
Fix
1. make melee-item-durability decrease once per swing (it was framerate dependent before)
2. change SolarWeather progression from linear to linear+sinusoidal+random-variation (this change results in a "swelling and receding" effect for SolarIntensity)
3. make DayAttacks random
4. improve "Ellen" shirt/back graphic glitch
5. remove footstep-landing-sound at the beginning of each phase

Balance
1. reduce the negative consequences of status effects (e.g. injury doesn't reduce speed as much)

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Combat and Item Glow Update
notes.content:
A. Balance
[olist]
[*] make game difficulty affect object glow-frequency and glow-distance (the distance at which objects start glowing)
[list]
[*] at easy difficulty, items will glow more frequently and at a greater distance
[/list]
[*] add mini-stun mechanic
[list]
[*]upon receiving damage, zombies will be mini-stunned
[*]the duration of the stun depends on:
[list]
[*] i. weapon type (heavy weapons add more stun time)
[*] ii. enemy type (fallen are stunned for less time than others)
[*] iii. headshot/sneak-attack[/list][/list]
[*] improve fast zombie approach&attack AI
[/olist]

B. Other
[olist]
[*] add blood pools to recently killed zombies
[*] add more zombie hit reaction animations
[*] add camera shakes and distinct gore sounds to melee head-shots, sneak attacks
[*] add unique thumbnails for unique items
[/olist]
